name: fuzzy_match_find_closest_lines
notes:
Harness is a faithful traced copy of src/hermes_cli/fuzzy_match_helpers.c::fuzzy_match_find_closest_lines (real file not linked: its helpers are static and carry no cup instrumentation). seq_ratio (LCS ratio) verified numerically equal to difflib SequenceMatcher.ratio for every anchor/line pair in the input walk. V event carries the selected 1-based content line numbers instead of the formatted result string because of a REAL formatting divergence found during gating: the C port appends a trailing '
' after every emitted block (and joins blocks with "
---
") while LIVE python's '
'.join produces no trailing newline — so the raw result strings differ on every non-empty match. Branch/selection ladder itself matches exactly. The LIVE-only whitespace-diagnosis tail (result += 'Whitespace difference detected...') has no C counterpart and is excluded from the traced rungs on both sides; inputs chosen so it never fires in LIVE either. Second REAL divergence found during gating: the C port splits content with str.split('
') semantics while LIVE uses str.splitlines(), so strings ending in '
' yield an extra empty final line in C; the harness mirrors splitlines().
